subject: SolidGeometry
question: Andrew has seven pieces of wire of lengths $1 \mathrm{~cm}, 2 \mathrm{~cm}, 3 \mathrm{~cm}, 4 \mathrm{~cm}$, $5 \mathrm{~cm}, 6 \mathrm{~cm}$ and $7 \mathrm{~cm}$. He bends some of the pieces to form a wire frame in the shape of a cube with edges of length $1 \mathrm{~cm}$ without any overlaps. What is the smallest number of these pieces that he can use? <image1>
